description: This file implements a WebRTC connection class for Pipecat using aiortc, including signaling, track management, connection handling, and data channels.

classes.name: TrackStatusMessage
classes.description: Message model for updating track enabled/disabled status.

classes.name: RenegotiateMessage
classes.description: Message model for requesting WebRTC renegotiation.

classes.name: PeerLeftMessage
classes.description: Message model indicating a peer has left the connection.

classes.name: SignallingMessage
classes.description: Union type for signaling messages, with inbound and outbound variants.

classes.name: SmallWebRTCTrack
classes.description: Wrapper class for aiortc MediaStreamTrack with enable/disable and frame discard functionality.

classes.name: SmallWebRTCConnection
classes.description: Main class implementing WebRTC peer connection with signaling, track management, and connection state handling.

methods.name: set_enabled
methods.description: Enable or disable the track.

methods.name: is_enabled
methods.description: Check if the track is currently enabled.

methods.name: discard_old_frames
methods.description: Discard old frames from the track queue to reduce latency.

methods.name: recv
methods.description: Receive the next frame from the track.

methods.name: _idle_watcher
methods.description: Monitor track activity and disable if idle for too long.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stop receiving frames and clean up.

methods.name: __getattr__
methods.description: Forward attribute access to the underlying track.

methods.name: _initialize
methods.description: Initialize the peer connection and related components.

methods.name: _setup_listeners
methods.description: Set up event listeners for the peer connection.

methods.name: _create_answer
methods.description: Create an SDP answer for a given offer.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initialize connection with an SDP offer.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establish the WebRTC connection and handle initial setup.

methods.name: renegotiate
methods.description: Renegotiate the WebRTC connection with new parameters.

methods.name: force_transceivers_to_send_recv
methods.description: Set transceivers to sendrecv or recvonly mode.

methods.name: replace_audio_track
methods.description: Replace the audio track in the connection.

methods.name: replace_video_track
methods.description: Replace the video track in the connection.

methods.name: replace_screen_video_track
methods.description: Replace the screen video track.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Disconnect and close the peer connection.

methods.name: _close
methods.description: Close the connection and cleanup resources.

methods.name: get_answer
methods.description: Retrieve the SDP answer for the current connection.

methods.name: _monitoring_connecting_state
methods.description: Start timeout monitoring for connection state.

methods.name: _cancel_monitoring_connecting_state
methods.description: Cancel connection state timeout monitoring.

methods.name: _handle_new_connection_state
methods.description: Handle changes in connection state.

methods.name: is_connected
methods.description: Check if the WebRTC connection is active.

methods.name: audio_input_track
methods.description: Get the audio input track wrapper.

methods.name: video_input_track
methods.description: Get the video input track wrapper.

methods.name: screen_video_input_track
methods.description: Get the screen video input track wrapper.

methods.name: send_app_message
methods.description: Send a message via data channel.

methods.name: ask_to_renegotiate
methods.description: Request renegotiation of the connection.

methods.name: _handle_signalling_message
methods.description: Process incoming signaling messages.

methods.name: add_ice_candidate
methods.description: Add remote ICE candidate.
